title: Children of God
speaker: Ryan Baird
summary: There is no greater way to show love than to bring someone into your family. That is what the Father has done for us, and what we will be has not yet appeared.
exhortation: Take a step back this morning and marvel at the love of God the Father. Ponder what kind of love he has lavished on us. His love isn't cheap or trite. It isn't some cheesy romantic-comedy love. It goes so far that it brings us into his family. There really isn't anything greater someone can do to show their love than to bring you into their family and make you their own.

Adoption may be one of the most powerful pictures we can imagine. My wife and daughter recently went to a ceremony where a girl was officially adopted, and many people from our church were there. When they came back, they were so moved. It was incredibly emotional to see the weight of that moment as she was joined to her family. The one who is adopted has a family, a mother and a father, an inheritance. She is called by a new name, provided for, cared for and loved. That is exactly what the Father has done for us: we are called children of God, given new life and sheltered under his wings.

And it gets even better. "What we will be has not yet appeared; but we know that when he appears we shall be like him, because we shall see him as he is." When we see Jesus, our older brother, we will be like him, finally and completely part of God's family.

So as this passage ends, let's put our hope in Christ, because everyone who hopes in him purifies himself as he is pure. Lord, set our minds on you, fix our eyes on you, Jesus, and let us remember your mighty works.
prayer: Jesus, thank you for coming and sacrificing yourself so that we might be adopted into the family of God, children bought by blood and given the rights and benefits of our older brother. It is so undeserved, so marvelous and amazing. Fill our hearts with gratitude for what you've done, and make us aware of your love for us today.

For those racked with guilt because of sin, I pray your Holy Spirit would come and bring repentance to their hearts, so that they understand and feel your love for them: that you loved us enough to come and shed your own blood. In Jesus' name, amen.
